label: TrueNAS M40 2U dual-controller NAS
description: 2U dual-controller enterprise NAS; each controller has two 10/25GbE data ports in SFP28 cages plus two 10GBASE-T ports and a 1GbE management port. The second controller carries the same set.
notes: Only one controller's ports are modelled. Data NICs are 2x 10/25/40GbE SFP28 cages (modelled at 10/25G - the 40GbE mode needs a QSFP+ optic, which this model does not represent) plus 2x 10GBASE-T copper. Management is a dedicated 1GbE port with IPMI. MTU/jumbo frames and LACP are standard.
